text: A nimble ember spirit. It gathers sparks before a burning bolt.
Hunted, it also drops a one-in-three chance of Blaze Powder.
Cinder Imps flit through the March Highlands and the Glimmer Ridge, and are most common in the Ember Wastes.

It has **18 health** and **1 armour** and is immune to fire. From up to 12 blocks away it casts a bolt for **4 damage** that sets you alight for 2 seconds. The bolt never ignites terrain. Cover breaks the cast.
pages.title: Where and how

text: A Cinder Knot attunes into 2 Attuned Echoes under Spirit.
pages.title: What it gives

text: Reach **Voice** with the **Drumhearts**, then use a Bonding Charm on an adult: two tries in five, charm spent on failure.
A bonded imp gives back a little Pulse each time you play a Drumheart by hand. See [familiar gifts](familiar_gifts).

Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, it drops this when hunted, more with Looting.
